_comment: STARTER FILE for importing endpoints straight from Salla's OpenAPI spec instead of hand-writing each contract. You name the operationIds you want; a converter reads this and emits full single-tool contracts, which then flow through the exact same gate as anything hand-written.
_comment_status: NOTE: no converter consumes this yet. The schema accepts the kind so the lane exists and can be reviewed, but importing is still a manual copy today.
_comment_operations: Only these operationIds are imported. Importing a whole spec unreviewed is exactly what the gate exists to prevent -- Salla publishes hundreds of endpoints and almost none of them belong in an agent's tool list.

defaults._comment: Applied to every imported operation unless an override says otherwise. Scopes are NOT set here: they are read per-operation from the spec, because each endpoint declares its own.

_comment_overrides: 'overrides' is keyed by operationId -- use it to add the selection hints a spec cannot express, or to tighten governance on one operation. The comment lives out here because every key inside 'overrides' is treated as an operationId.

whenToUse: The merchant asks which coupons exist or which are still active.
whenNotToUse: The merchant named one coupon -- use Coupon-Details instead.
